title: INVESTIGATOR settings export (V1)
description: A file of INVESTIGATOR's settings, from Import/Export in its settings: what Import reads back.

$schema.description: The schema for this file, so an editor can check it: ignored by INVESTIGATOR.

defaultThemeName.description: The id of the theme to use. If you are registering a custom theme, it should match the id you used.

generalAbilityCategories.description: Categories for general abilities. For many systems, this will just be "General".

combatAbilities.description: List of ability names that can be used in combat. This may be removed in future in favour or just flagging abilities as "combat usable".

occupationLabel.description: What do we call the main, short descriptive text for a PC in this system?

personalDetails.description: What personalDetails do we need? This replaces the old shortNotes config.

longNotes.description: What groups of notes to we need per character?

newPCPacks.description: What compendium packs should be automatically added to new PCs

newNPCPacks.description: What compendium packs should be automatically added to new NPCs

useBoost.description: Can abilities be boosted in this system?

hideTestDifficulty.description: When the GM sets a test's Difficulty, do players see only whether it succeeded, and not the number?

defaultTestDifficulty.description: The Difficulty a test starts with, which the tester can change: a number, or null to ask the GM for it before the dice are rolled. Defaults to 4.

genericOccupation.description: What string to use when a PC's occupation is empty Defaults to "Investigator"

showEmptyInvestigativeCategories.description: Should empty investigative categories be shown? Default is yes, because in most GUMSHOE games, characters will have a smattering of abuilities across all the categories. But in some, the categories represent professional specialisations and you don't want to see e.g. Warrior abilities on your Sorceror sheet.

useMwStyleAbilities.description: Ignore this unless you are doing something based on the DERPG  system.

mwHiddenShortNotes.description: Ignore this unless you are doing something based on the DERPG  system.

mwUseAlternativeItemTypes.description: Ignore this unless you are doing something based on the DERPG  system.

useMwInjuryStatus.description: Ignore this unless you are doing something based on the DERPG  system.

useNpcCombatBonuses.description: Do NPCs get fix bonuses on combat abilities?

useTurnPassingInitiative.description: Use turn-passing initiative, AKA popcorn or lancer-style.

useDamageApplication.description: Record targets on attack rolls, check hits against their Hit Thresholds, and let users apply damage to their Health from the chat card.

useGunfireOnHumans.description: Fall of DELTA GREEN: gunfire damage which would leave a human Hurt does an extra 6 points. Only applies with damage application.

useCriticalHits.description: A successful unmodified 6 with a margin of 5 or more rolls two instances of damage and adds them together. Only applies with damage application.

useLethalityAndAutofire.description: Fall of DELTA GREEN: weapons can have a Lethality rating (e.g. L1*), which can kill or wound outright, and automatic weapons can fire three-round bursts and full-auto (whose damage is Lethality). Only applies with damage application.

useShotDryAndJams.description: Fall of DELTA GREEN: an unmodified 6 on full-auto shoots the weapon dry (with extra damage), and two 1s in a row jam it. Only applies with Lethality and autofire.

useExtendedRange.description: Fall of DELTA GREEN: weapons can have an Extended range band, and any range can need a spend (which doesn't add to the roll) before you can shoot at it at all (p. 098)

useWalkingFire.description: Fall of DELTA GREEN: after a burst or full-auto attack, pay to "walk" the fire onto another target the original result would hit. Only applies with Lethality and autofire.

useWoundStatusEffects.description: Keep the Hurt, Seriously Wounded and Dead status effects in step with Health: when an actor's wound state changes, the old state's status is removed and the new one's applied.

walkingFireSpendAbilities.description: Names of other abilities which can pay part of the cost of walking fire. Defaults to Athletics.

fullAutoSpendAbilities.description: Names of other abilities whose points count towards full-auto's minimum spend, without adding to the roll. Defaults to Athletics and Stability.

equipmentCategories.description: What standard categories do we have for equipment?

useStabilityRules.description: Stability rules (Fall of DELTA GREEN and others): turns on the Sanity & Stability settings below. Nothing below does anything without it.

stabilityAbility.description: The name of the Stability ability: Bonds are spent on it, its pool sets the Stability state, and trauma tests are made with it. Defaults to Stability.

useSanityRules.description: Sanity rules: the Sanity ability's rating is capped, and trauma types can cost Sanity.

sanityAbility.description: The name of the Sanity ability. Defaults to Sanity.

sanityCapAbility.description: The ability whose rating comes off the Sanity cap, e.g. Cthulhu Mythos.

sanityCapBase.description: The Sanity cap before the cap ability's rating comes off it. Defaults to 10.

useStabilityStates.description: Shaken, Shattered and Gone follow the Stability pool.

stabilityStates.description: The names of the Stability states, and the highest pool in each.

useBonds.description: Should PCs have Bonds (Fall of DELTA GREEN)? If so, they appear (and they can spend on Stability), on their own tab.

bondRebuildSpendCategory.description: The investigative ability category whose points can be spent when rebuilding a Bond between operations. Defaults to Interpersonal.

traumaTypes.description: The kinds of trauma Stability can be tested against.

useNetworkContacts.description: Network contacts (Fall of DELTA GREEN, Night's Black Agents): PCs reveal contacts, each with a pool of points taken from the Network ability.

networkAbility.description: The name of the ability contacts' points come from. Defaults to Network.

cardCategories.description: What categories do we have for cards?

systemPreset.description: The id of the preset the settings came from.

notifyItemAddedToActor.description: Tell everyone when an item is added to an actor.

placement.description: Where a PC's sheet shows this stat: with the name and personal details (the default), or on the combat tab (e.g. Hit threshold). NPCs ignore it.

Stat.description: A definition for a countable value that all PCs or NPCs will have

visibleToLimited.description: Whether people with Limited permission on the item can see this field (default true)
Whether people with Limited permission on the item can see this field (default true)
Whether people with Limited permission on the item can see this field (default true)

upTo.description: the highest Stability pool in this state

cappedAbilities.description: abilities whose ratings are capped once adapted

refreshPenalty.description: what comes off each refresh once adapted
